channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Diyaaradda Beşiktaş oo hillaac ku dhacay, loona leexiyay Rize kahor kulanka Europa League
item.description: Diyaaradda gaarka ah ee kooxda Beşiktaş ayaa Khamiistii 26 November dhowr jeer hillaac ku dhacay iyadoo u socotay Batumi ee Georgia, waxaana loo leexiyay garoonka Rize-Artvin ee Turkiga kahor kulanka Europa League ee Hapoel Beer Sheva.

item.title: Salva Kiir oo xiray wadahadalka axsaabta, xisbiyaduna oggolaadeen khariidadda doorashada 2027
item.description: Madaxweynaha Koonfur Suudaan Salva Kiir ayaa Khamiistii 26 November si rasmi ah u xiray wadahadalka xisbiyada siyaasadda ee Juba, iyadoo xisbiyada ka qaybgalay ay ansixiyeen go'aanno ku saabsan doorashooyinka guud ee loo qorsheeyay 11 February 2027.

item.title: Kubadda gacanta: Goolhayaha Jarmalka Andreas Wolff oo 2028 ka dhaqaaqaya THW Kiel kuna biiraya Gummersbach
item.description: Goolhayaha xulka qaranka Jarmalka ee kubadda gacanta, Andreas Wolff, ayaa heshiis afar sano ah u saxiixay kooxda VfL Gummersbach, wuxuuna ka iman doonaa THW Kiel sannadka 2028.

item.title: Marseille: Timothy Weah iyo Geoffrey Kondogbia oo ka maqan kulanka Levski Sofia
item.description: Tababaraha Olympique de Marseille, Bruno Genesio, ayaa Khamiistii 26 November shaaciyay 23 ciyaaryahan oo loogu yeeray kulanka Levski Sofia ee Europa League, iyadoo kabtanka Timothy Weah iyo Geoffrey Kondogbia aysan ku jirin.

item.title: Museveni oo la filayo inuu Muqdisho yimaado: Xalane mise Madaxtooyada? Su'aalo xasaasi ah oo ku xeran booqashadiisa
item.description: Madaxweynaha Uganda, Yoweri Museveni, ayaa la filayaa inuu 2-da December 2026 yimaado Muqdisho, iyadoo la isweydiinayo halka uu kula kulmi doono Xasan Sheekh iyo haddii booqashadu ka baxsan doonto amniga iyo xiriirka labada dal.

item.title: AFC oo baaritaan ku billowday garsoore laga beddelay nasashada kulanka Al Jazira iyo Gol Gohar
item.description: Ururka Kubadda Cagta Aasiya (AFC) ayaa baaritaan ku billaabay xaaladda garsooraha Suuriyaanka ah Hanna Hattab, kadib markii laga beddelay nasashada kulanka Al Jazira iyo Gol Gohar ee AFC Champions League Two oo ka dhacay Abu Dhabi.

item.title: Oliver Bearman oo heshiis cusub la saxiixday Haas, kooxda ayuu u kaxayn doonaa 2027
item.description: Darawalka reer Britain ee Oliver Bearman, oo 21 jir ah, ayaa sii joogi doona kooxda Haas ee Formula 1 xilli-ciyaareedka 2027, kadib markii kooxdu Khamiistii ku dhawaaqday heshiiskiisa cusub, bilowga toddobaadka Qatar Grand Prix.

item.title: Qarax ka dhacay kayd shidaal oo ku yaal bariga Bangkok, dadka deegaanka oo laga codsaday inay ka guuraan
item.description: Qarax xooggan ayaa Khamiistii ka dhacay kayd shidaal oo ku yaal bariga magaalada Bangkok ee dalka Thailand, kaas oo cirka u diray olol weyn iyo qiiq madow oo culus, halka mas'uuliyiinta deegaanka ay dadka ku nool agagaarka ku boorriyeen inay isla markiiba ka guuraan.

item.title: Bangiga Dhexe ee Rwanda oo dulsaarka u kordhiyay 9.5% si loo xakameeyo sicir-bararka
item.description: Bangiga Qaranka ee Rwanda (BNR) ayaa Khamiistii 26 November heerka dulsaarka bangiga dhexe ka qaaday 8.75% una qaaday 9.5%, kadib markii sicir-bararku gaaray 19.5% bishii October, una badan kor u kaca qiimaha cuntada.

item.title: Frank Garcia oo ku wareegaya Afrika: Mas'uulka diblomaasiyadda Mareykanka ee Afrika oo ku wajahan Uganda
item.description: Mas'uulka ugu sarreeya diblomaasiyadda Mareykanka ee Afrika, Frank W. Garcia Jr., ayaa la sheegay inuu ku wajahan yahay Uganda, xilli Washington ay dib u habeyneyso siyaasaddeeda Afrika ee ku saleysan ganacsi, maalgashi iyo amni.

item.title: Joan Mir oo ku soo laabanaya MotoGP-ga tartanka Valencia, kaas oo noqonaya kii ugu dambeeyay ee uu u kaxeeyo Honda
item.description: Darawalka reer Spain ee Joan Mir ayaa loo oggolaaday inuu ka qayb galo tartanka ugu dambeeya xilli-ciyaareedka MotoGP ee Valencia, kaas oo noqonaya tartankiisii ugu dambeeyay ee kooxda Honda HRC ka hor inta uusan u wareegin Ducati Gresini.

item.title: Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cirro oo Hargeysa dib ugu soo laabtay kadib 17 maalmood oo uu Imaaraadka ku maqnaa
item.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa Khamiistii 26 November dib ugu soo laabtay Hargeysa, kadib safar ku dhow 17 maalmood oo uu ku joogay Imaaraadka Carabta, xilli uu khilaafka Muqdisho iyo Abu Dhabi heer sare marayo.

item.title: Real Madrid oo noqotay kooxdii ugu horreysay ee u gudubta wareegga xiga ee Champions League
item.description: Waxaa la xaqiijiyay inay u gudubtay wareegga knockout-ka ee Champions League, iyadoo 15 dhibcood ka heshay shanteeda kulan ee wareegga horyaalka, kadib natiijooyinkii Arbacada oo ay ku jirtay barbardhaca PSG iyo Roma.

item.title: Ebola-da Congo oo dhaaftay 12,000 xaaladood, dagaallada bariga oo carqaladeeyay la dagaallanka cudurka
item.description: Tirada xaaladaha Ebola ee la xaqiijiyay ee Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Congo ayaa gaartay ugu yaraan 12,021, halka 5,904 qof ay u dhinteen, sida ay muujinayso xogta dowladda ee Khamiista, iyadoo dagaallada gobolka Ituri ay caqabad ku noqdeen gurmadka.

item.title: LeBron James oo 76ers kula diiwaangeliyay triple-double-kiisii ugu horreeyay, Philadelphia oo 111-104 ku garaacday Miami
item.description: LeBron James ayaa 25 dhibcood, 10 kubbadood oo soo boodday iyo 12 caawin u diiwaangeliyay Philadelphia 76ers, taas oo ahayd triple-double-kiisii ugu horreeyay kooxdan, iyagoo 111-104 ku garaacay Miami Heat, kooxdiisii hore.

item.title: Rockets oo 116-104 kaga adkaaday Suns, Brooks oo la saaray kadib muran uu la galay Durant
item.description: Houston Rockets ayaa Arbacadii 25 November 116-104 kaga adkaaday Phoenix Suns kulan NBA Cup ah, iyadoo Dillon Brooks laga saaray garoonka ilbiriqsiyada ugu dambeeya kadib muran uu la galay Kevin Durant.

item.title: Boca Juniors oo 2-0 ku garaacday Independiente Rivadavia, una gudubtay rubuc-finalka Torneo Clausura
item.description: Boca Juniors, oo dhawaan ku guuleysatay Copa Sudamericana, ayaa Arbacadii 2-0 kaga adkaatay Independiente Rivadavia, waxayna u gudubtay rubuc-finalka Torneo Clausura ee horyaalka Argentina.

item.title: Portland oo 116-111 ku garaacday San Antonio Spurs inkastoo Wembanyama dhaliyay 44 dhibcood
item.description: Portland Trail Blazers ayaa Arbacadii garoonkeeda 116-111 kaga adkaatay San Antonio Spurs, taas oo ahayd guuldarradii ugu horreysay ee Spurs xilli-ciyaareedkan kala kulmaan kulan ay martida ahaayeen, inkastoo Victor Wembanyama uu dhaliyay 44 dhibcood.

item.title: Jannik Sinner oo ka baxay Australian Open kadib qalliinkii jilibka
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka tennis-ka Talyaaniga Jannik Sinner, oo ah kaalinta labaad adduunka, ma ka qayb geli doono Australian Open ee Janaayo, kadib qalliin lagu sameeyay jilibkiisa midig toddobaadkan.

item.title: Bangiga dhexe ee Kuuriyada Koonfureed oo dulsaarka kordhiyay, korriinka dhaqaalahana qiimeyntiisa kor u qaaday
item.description: Bangiga dhexe ee Kuuriyada Koonfureed ayaa Khamiista dulsaarka aasaasiga ah 0.25 dhibcood ku kordhiyay ilaa 3.25 boqolkiiba, isagoo tilmaamay korriinka xooggan ee dhaqaalaha iyo sicir-bararka ka sarreeya bartilmaameedka.

item.title: Trump iyo madaxa NATO oo Ruushka ugu baaqay inuu ka fogaado ballaarinta dagaalka Ukraine
item.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee NATO Mark Rutte ayaa bayaan wadajir ah ugu baaqay Ruushka inuu ka fogaado tallaabo kasta oo ballaarisa dagaalka Ukraine, kadib kulan albaabadu u xirnaayeen oo ka dhacay Mar-a-Lago.

item.title: NBA: Timberwolves oo 113-106 kaga adkaatay Thunder, LaMelo Ball oo dhaawac canqowga ah ka soo gaaray
item.description: Minnesota Timberwolves ayaa 113-106 kaga guuleysatay Oklahoma City Thunder kulan ka tirsan NBA Cup, iyadoo Jaden McDaniels uu dhaliyay 32 dhibcood, halka LaMelo Ball uu kulanka uga baxay dhaawac canqowga bidix ah.

item.title: Indonesia: 13 shaqaale oo ku dhintay macdanta dahabka ee daadku qarqiyay, 13 kale weli lama hayo
item.description: Kooxaha samatabixinta ee Indonesia ayaa Khamiista helay meydadka 13 shaqaale oo ku dhintay macdan dahab oo aan sharci ahayn oo ku taalla degmada Bogor, halka 13 kale weli la la'yahay.

item.title: NFL: Rams oo 26-13 kaga adkaatay Packers, Blake Corum oo dhigay rikoorkiisa ugu sarreeya
item.description: Los Angeles Rams ayaa Arbacadda 26-13 kaga guuleysatay Green Bay Packers, taas oo ah guushoodii shanaad ee isku xigta, iyadoo Blake Corum uu orday 184 yaard oo ah tirada ugu badan ee xirfaddiisa.

item.title: Brazil oo ku tilmaantay 'mid aan la aqbali karin' canshuuraha cusub ee Mareykanku soo jeediyay
item.description: Xafiiska madaxweynaha Brazil Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva ayaa sheegay in Brazil aysan u hoggaansami doonin hanjabaadda Mareykanka, kadib markii Washington ay soo jeedisay canshuuro cusub oo saaran diyaaradaha iyo sonkorta Brazil.

item.title: Kenya: Laanqayrta Cas oo ka digtay daadad hor leh oo ka dhaca Tana Delta, 600 qoys oo barakacay
item.description: Laanqayrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa ka digtay in dad kale ay ku barakici karaan Tana Delta, iyadoo roobabka ka da'aya buuraha sare ay sii xumeyn karaan fatahaadda webiga.

item.title: OCHA: Yaraanta lacagta gargaarka oo keentay in Soomaaliya laga xiro 233 xarumood oo nafaqo
item.description: Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee isku-duwidda arrimaha bani'aadannimada (OCHA) ayaa ka digay in malaayiin Soomaali ah ay waayi karaan adeegyada gargaarka, kadib markii yaraanta lacagta ay keentay in la xiro ugu yaraan 233 xarumood oo nafaqo.

item.title: Mareykanka oo SpaceX u oggolaaday inay gantaal ku dirto ilaa hal milyan oo dayax-gacmeed oo xarumo xog ah
item.description: Guddiga Isgaarsiinta Federaalka ee Mareykanka (FCC) ayaa Arbacadii u oggolaaday shirkadda SpaceX ee Elon Musk inay hawada sare u dirto ilaa 1 milyan oo dayax-gacmeed, oo loogu talagalay in lagu dhiso xarumo xog-keyd ah oo ku yaal meeraha agtiisa.

item.title: Kim Jong Un oo ku baaqay in Kuuriyada Waqooyi ay ballaariso hubka nukliyeerka ee taatikada ah
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha Kuuriyada Waqooyi Kim Jong Un ayaa ku baaqay in dalkiisu uu hub nukliyeer taatiko ah ka hawlgeliyo goobo badan oo hawlo kala duwan leh, isagoo sheegay in awoodda soo saarista walxaha nukliyeerka si nidaamsan loo ballaarinayo.

item.title: Ukraine oo sheegtay inay weerar ku qaadday saldhigga ciidamada cirka ee Savasleyka, shan diyaaradoodna ku waxyeelleysay
item.description: Taliska Guud ee Ciidamada Ukraine ayaa sheegay in ciidamadiisu ay weerar ku qaadeen saldhigga ciidamada cirka ee Savasleyka ee gobolka Nizhny Novgorod, bariga Moscow, kana waxyeelleeyeen shan diyaaradood oo dagaal.
